context_length: Effectively unbounded via T5 relative position bias
summary: A half-precision, encoder-only distribution of ProtT5-XL-UniRef50; the same 1024-dim representations at roughly half the memory/compute of the full model.
architecture: Identical T5-3B encoder to ProtT5-XL-UniRef50, shipped as encoder-only float16 weights; produces 1024-dim per-residue embeddings.
pretraining_data: BFD then UniRef50 (same as the full ProtT5-XL-UniRef50).
key_innovations: fp16 encoder-only packaging removes the unused decoder and halves memory
Near-identical embeddings to the full-precision model at lower cost
when_to_use: Prefer over the full ProtT5-XL when memory/throughput matters; expect essentially the same embedding quality. Useful for large-scale embedding of the protein pool.
caveats: fp16 can introduce tiny numerical differences vs full precision; still a single-sequence model with the older ProtTrans recipe.
